trailhead.label: The Von-Kurz-Platz, the village square of Niederdorf

cautions: About 1.6 km on village streets and lanes in Niederdorf, where cars come and go: keep your dog on a short lead.
One crossing of the busy Pustertaler Straße (SS49) on the Maistattweg at about km 2.3: cross with great care.
Several gates on the Langerl track across the meadows: close them behind you.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
